$comment: The release this project measures itself against, and the facts that identify it.
Read by the `Reference release is intact` step in release-dmg.yml, which fails the
build if the tag disappears or moves. GitHub-side tag protection is not available on
this repository's plan — rulesets need Pro or a public repository, and immutable
releases are not offered — so the guarantee lives here, where it is ours to enforce.
Changing any value below is a deliberate act and shows up in the diff as one.

reference.why: First release of the numbering that survives; everything before it was withdrawn.
